title: Lace Ruffle Sleeve A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This lace evening dress feels soft, elegant, and easy to wear. The V-neckline frames the upper body beautifully, while the short sleeves add light coverage and a refined finish. With its defined waist and flowing skirt, it is a graceful choice for evening parties, formal dinners, and other special occasions.


Tips: Prioritize selecting based on the bust measurement; the entire garment is stretchy, and the waist and hip areas can stretch by at least 2 inches.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
